Author: Kathy Auteberry (fork of EchoXIV by ssalazar217)
Name: Kotodama
Description:
Kotodama is a personal fork of EchoXIV focused on fast, accurate Japanese<->English chat translation for Japanese PF raiding and everyday social chat, powered by a local LLM.

Based on EchoXIV by ssalazar217: https://github.com/ssalazar217/EchoXIV
Punchline: Japanese<->English chat translation with a local LLM. Fork of EchoXIV.
